ns2:course.label: Research Project II
ns2:course.description: In this lecture/discussion course, which is a continuation of VM 622, students will work in groups, each led by a faculty mentor. The groups will conduct the research project that was planned and proposed in VM 622, analyze the data, and prepare a scientific manuscript for publication. No graduate credit. 2 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Good standing in the veterinary curriculum.
